round2_dispositions.evidence: To do group is drawn above Connect mail (inbox-todos.png).
Date labels: "Fri" grey, "Today" amber, third row none; no rule for when a date shows or turns amber is stated in the plan.
Verified in the browser: clicking the row text or the date leaves all 3 rows; only the checkbox removes one (matches the plan: only the checkbox acts).
The consent-off state is not drawn on the Inbox phone frame; only the Integrations "AI data sharing off" row exists.

new_findings.description: Ticking a to-do removes the row immediately with no undo and no brief completed state. iOS Reminders-style lists show the check first and offer undo; an accidental tap on the 44 pt circle loses the row from view.
new_findings.expected: A short completed state or undo.
new_findings.actual: Row gone at once (inbox-after-tick.png); the plan keeps this existing behavior.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Optional: keep the checked circle for about a second before removing, or add shake-to-undo. Not required for the plan.
